    def test_search_finds_text_in_title_or_body(self):
        self.store.add("ann", "Ideas", "plant a tree")
        self.store.add("ben", "Tree house", "for the garden")
        answer = call(self.store, "token-ann", "GET", "/notes?q=tree")
        self.assertEqual([item["title"] for item in json.loads(answer.body)["items"]], ["Ideas"])
        answer = call(self.store, "token-ann", "GET", "/notes?q=shop")
        self.assertEqual([item["title"] for item in json.loads(answer.body)["items"]], ["Shopping"])

    def test_search_ignores_case(self):
        answer = call(self.store, "token-ann", "GET", "/notes?q=MILK")
        self.assertEqual([item["title"] for item in json.loads(answer.body)["items"]], ["Shopping"])

    def test_list_without_q_is_unchanged(self):
        answer = call(self.store, "token-ann", "GET", "/notes")
